source_batch.unit_label: BRBL::MOD_D::U21: Apply expert consent,compliance and misstatement-liability distinctions

payload.title: A technically true sentence can still mislead
payload.core_explanation_md:
Disclosure analysis includes the context and material omissions, not just whether each isolated sentence is literally true. Expert statements require the described consent and independence checks; a quotation cannot be added merely because a report is publicly available. Filing, date, signature and applicable application-document requirements also need the current statutory route.

Civil and criminal consequences have different conditions, responsible-person tests and defences. Section34 addresses misleading statements and omissions through its section 447 reference and stated defences. Do not promise automatic conviction or automatic compensation for every inaccuracy. Preserve the document version, authorisation, materiality, reliance and loss evidence so the appropriate remedy can be analysed.

self_check.prompt_text: Can material context make a literally true statement misleading?
self_check.expected_takeaway: Yes. Context and omissions form part of the analysis.

payload.stem_md: A prospectus quotes an expert without establishing the required written consent and non-withdrawal. What is missing?

options.explanation_md: Public availability is not the required consent.

options.text_md: A rule that no expert may ever be mentioned
options.explanation_md: The source permits statements subject to conditions.
That is irrelevant and should not be requested.

payload.correct_explanation_md: Public availability is not the required consent.

payload.stem_md: A material omission induced investment, and a note assumes civil damages and criminal conviction follow identically without further proof. What is required?

options.explanation_md: That does not establish both consequences.

options.text_md: Separate the applicable liability conditions, defences and remedy evidence
options.explanation_md: The routes have different legal requirements.

payload.correct_explanation_md: The routes have different legal requirements.
